tests.title: authorizeGitAccess returns nil for owner, member and admin token, taking the decision from wsaccess
given: workspace W in org O owned by user-a with a ready clone
user-b is a member of O, user-2 is a stranger
an echo context with c.Path() set to the upload-pack route template
tests.when: authorizeGitAccess is called with the AuthInfo of the owner, the member, an admin token with UserID empty, and the stranger
then: owner, member and admin token calls return nil and write no response
the stranger call writes HTTP 404 and returns errAccessDenied
the admin token passes although it has no org_members row and no owner match, proving the decision is not made by a local owner/admin check
tests.pseudocode: for who in [owner, member, admin]: assert authorizeGitAccess(c, db, ws) == nil; assert authorizeGitAccess(ctx(stranger), db, ws) == errAccessDenied; assert rec.Code == 404

tests.title: authorizeGitAccess returns 401 when no AuthInfo is on the context
given: an echo context with no AuthInfo set
a ready workspace W
tests.when: authorizeGitAccess is called
then: it returns an *echo.HTTPError with Code 401
no response body is written
no membership or binding query was made
tests.pseudocode: err = authorizeGitAccess(c, db, ws); he = err.(*echo.HTTPError); assert he.Code == 401; assert rec.Body.Len() == 0

tests.title: No non-test Go source in internal/gitserver compares an owner id with the caller
given: the non-test .go files of internal/gitserver parsed with go/parser
tests.when: the syntax trees are scanned for binary == or != expressions with a selector or identifier named OwnerID/owner_id on one side and UserID on the other, and for calls to DeniesWorkspace and string comparisons against "admin_token" in authz.go
then: no such comparison exists
authz.go contains no call to wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace and no CredentialType admin_token check
authz.go contains a call to wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspaceAt
tests.pseudocode: for f in nonTestFiles: ast.Inspect(f, func(n){ if be is BinaryExpr && mentions(be,'OwnerID') && mentions(be,'UserID') -> fail })

tests.title: A refusal from authorizeGitAccess yields exactly one response through the resolver
given: the full git handler chain mounted on an echo server with an in-memory database
workspace W with a ready clone and a stranger's API key
tests.when: the stranger sends GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack, and POST git-upload-pack
then: each response is HTTP 404 with body exactly the single pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
the body contains no second response or appended handler output
authorizeGitAccess still has the signature (echo.Context, *sql.DB, *workspaceInfo) error
tests.pseudocode: code, body = infoRefs(W, upload, strangerKey); assert body == encodePktLine('ERR repository not found\n')

tests.title: Receive-pack requests carry NeedWrite so a member is refused and the owner is not
given: workspace W in org O owned by user-a with a ready repository
user-b is a member of O
tests.when: user-b and user-a (API keys) send GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack and POST git-receive-pack (empty body)
then: user-b gets HTTP 403 pkt-line "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n" on both requests
user-a gets HTTP 200 on both requests
tests.pseudocode: for req in [infoRefs(receive), postReceivePack]: assert do(member,req).code == 403; assert do(owner,req).code == 200

tests.title: Upload-pack and any other info/refs service value carry NeedRead
given: workspace W with a ready repository
user-b is a member of org O
tests.when: user-b sends POST git-upload-pack, GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack, GET info/refs with service=foo, with service empty and with no service
then: upload-pack requests return 200
the info/refs requests with an invalid, empty or missing service return the handler's 403 "ERR invalid or missing service parameter\n", not the read-only message
none of the requests is answered with 404
tests.pseudocode: assert body(member, service='foo') == pktline('ERR invalid or missing service parameter\n')

tests.title: A member's malformed info/refs request gets the same refusal as the owner's
given: workspace W with a ready clone
user-a is the owner and user-b is a member of org O
tests.when: each sends GET info/refs with a missing service and with service=bogus
then: both receive HTTP 403 with Content-Type text/plain
both bodies equal "ERR invalid or missing service parameter\n" in pkt-line encoding
member and owner responses are identical
tests.pseudocode: assert resp(member, q) == resp(owner, q) for q in ['', 'service=bogus']

tests.title: The git server never uses NeedPrivate: a member is never answered 404 for a ready workspace
given: workspace W with a ready clone in org O, user-b a member of O
tests.when: for any route among the three git routes and any service query value (random string, empty, upload-pack, receive-pack) requested by the member's API key
then: the response is never the stranger's 404
the status is 403 read-only exactly when the need is write, otherwise it is the handler's answer (200 or invalid-service 403)
tests.pseudocode: for route, svc in gen(): r = do(member, route, svc); assert r.code != 404; if need(route,svc)==WRITE: assert r.body == readOnlyMsg

tests.title: A member's API key or git:read/git:write PAT gets the owner's ref advertisement
given: workspace W in org O owned by user-a with a ready clone with a commit
user-b is a member of O with an API key, a git:read PAT and a git:write PAT
tests.when: each member credential and the owner send GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
then: every member response is HTTP 200
Content-Type and body equal the owner's response
tests.pseudocode: ref = infoRefs(owner); for cred in memberCreds: assert infoRefs(cred) == ref

tests.title: A member's upload-pack POST returns the same pack as the owner
given: workspace W with a ready clone
user-b is a member with an API key and PATs holding git:read and git:write
tests.when: owner and member credentials POST the same want/done upload-pack request body
then: all member responses are HTTP 200
Content-Type and pack content equal the owner's response
tests.pseudocode: assert post(member, body) == post(owner, body)

tests.title: A member's PAT without git scopes is refused by the scope check as an owner's would be
given: workspace W with a ready clone
a PAT of the member and a PAT of the owner, each with no git permissions
tests.when: each sends GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack and POST git-upload-pack
then: both get HTTP 403 with the echo JSON message "insufficient git permissions"
the member's response equals the owner's response, and is not a pkt-line
tests.pseudocode: assert resp(memberPat).code == 403 && resp(memberPat) == resp(ownerPat)

tests.title: A removed member is a stranger on the next request
given: user-b is a member of O and has just cloned from W successfully with 200
tests.when: the org_members row for user-b is deleted and user-b sends the same info/refs request again
then: the second response is HTTP 404
the body is the pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
tests.pseudocode: assert infoRefs(b).code==200; delete org_members; r = infoRefs(b); assert r.code==404 and r.body==pktline('ERR repository not found\n')

tests.title: A member's push discovery and receive-pack are refused with the read-only 403 whatever the credential
given: workspace W with a ready repository, user-b a member of O
user-b has an API key, a PAT with git:write, a PAT with git:read only and a PAT with no scopes
tests.when: each credential sends GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack and POST git-receive-pack
then: every response is HTTP 403 with Content-Type text/plain
the body is the pkt-line "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n"
the scope message "insufficient git permissions" never appears
tests.pseudocode: for cred, req in product: r = do(cred, req); assert r.code==403 and r.ct=='text/plain' and r.body==pktline(readOnlyMsg)

tests.title: A refused member push changes nothing in the workspace
given: workspace W with a ready repository with head_sha recorded and refs listed
a pre-receive hook and post-push hook installed as counters
an audit emitter counting hub.git.push events
a valid pack with a ref update to refs/heads/main built from a fresh commit
tests.when: user-b (member) POSTs git-receive-pack with that pack
then: the response is HTTP 403 read-only
the repository's refs and object count are unchanged
the pre-receive hook and post-push hook were called zero times
workspaces.head_sha is unchanged and the worktree was not reset
no hub.git.push audit event was emitted
tests.pseudocode: before = snapshot(); post(member, pack); assert snapshot()==before; assert hooks.calls==0; assert auditCount==0

tests.title: No audit event is written for any refused member push request
given: an audit store attached to the git server
user-b a member of W's org
tests.when: user-b sends GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack and POST git-receive-pack
then: both are refused with 403
the audit events table has the same row count as before the requests
tests.pseudocode: n = count(audit_events); do both; assert count(audit_events) == n

tests.title: A wsaccess 404 is written with the git server's own not-found text
given: a stranger caller and a ready workspace, a caller for a workspace whose row is missing
tests.when: authorizeGitAccess is called through the resolver
then: HTTP 404, Content-Type text/plain
body is pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n" and does not contain "workspace not found"
errAccessDenied is returned from authorizeGitAccess
tests.pseudocode: assert rec.Code==404; assert rec.Body.String()==encodePktLine('ERR repository not found\n'); assert err==errAccessDenied

tests.title: A wsaccess 403 is written as a pkt-line carrying the returned message
given: a member's AuthInfo and a ready workspace, context with receive-pack route template
tests.when: authorizeGitAccess is called
then: HTTP 403, Content-Type text/plain
body is pkt-line "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n"
errAccessDenied is returned
tests.pseudocode: err = authorizeGitAccess(c, db, ws); assert err==errAccessDenied; assert rec.Code==403; assert body==pktline('ERR '+msg+'\n')

tests.title: A database error during the access decision yields a 500 pkt-line and no repository is served
given: workspace W with a ready repository
the org_members table is dropped so the stranger's membership read fails
tests.when: a non-owner API key sends GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
then: the response is HTTP 500, Content-Type text/plain
the body is the pkt-line "ERR internal server error\n"
no ref advertisement is served and the handler is not reached
tests.pseudocode: exec('DROP TABLE org_members'); r = infoRefs(user2); assert r.code==500 and r.body==pktline('ERR internal server error\n')

tests.title: A stranger gets the 404 on all three routes without a binding lookup or report
given: workspace W with a ready clone
user-2 is neither owner nor member
a refusal observer is registered and a PAT of user-2 bound to another workspace is not used
tests.when: user-2 sends GET info/refs (both services), POST git-upload-pack and POST git-receive-pack with an API key and with an unbound PAT, with the binding table dropped
then: every response is HTTP 404 text/plain with body pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
no BoundRefusal is observed
tests.pseudocode: for route in routes: r = do(stranger, route); assert r.code==404 and r.body==notFound; assert len(observed)==0

tests.title: Owner and admin token answers are unchanged on all three routes
given: workspace W with a ready repository
the owner has an API key, a PAT with git:write, and a PAT with only git:read; an admin token exists
tests.when: each credential sends the info/refs (both services), upload-pack and receive-pack requests
then: the owner's API key and write PAT and the admin token get 200 on all routes
the owner's git:read PAT gets 200 on upload-pack but HTTP 403 "insufficient git permissions" (echo JSON) on receive-pack
the status, Content-Type and body equal those the same fixture gave before this change
tests.pseudocode: assert results == expectedToday[cred][route]

tests.title: An admin-role API key is not an admin token
given: user-2 has Role admin in users, is not W's owner and not a member of W's org
user-b has Role admin and is a member of W's org
tests.when: each sends upload-pack and receive-pack requests with an API key
then: user-2 gets 404 "ERR repository not found\n" on both
user-b gets 200 on upload-pack and 403 read-only on receive-pack
tests.pseudocode: assert do(adminRoleStranger).code==404; assert do(adminRoleMember, receive).code==403

tests.title: API key and admin token answers do not depend on the binding table
given: the same workspace and credentials, once with the binding table present and once with it dropped
tests.when: owner, member and stranger API keys and an admin token send upload-pack and receive-pack requests
then: each response with the table dropped equals the response with the table present
no response is a 500
tests.pseudocode: a = runAll(); exec('DROP TABLE token_workspace_bindings'); b = runAll(); assert a==b

tests.title: A blocked user is refused with 401 before the resolver
given: user-blocked is blocked, owns W or is a member of W's org
a counter on the resolver's workspace lookup
tests.when: the blocked user's API key and PAT hit each git route
then: every response is HTTP 401
the resolver is not reached
tests.pseudocode: for cred in [key, pat]: assert do(cred, route).code==401

tests.title: A PAT bound to S is refused on another workspace the user owns or is a member of, reported once
given: workspaces S and X in org O; X owned by user-a, and Y owned by user-b
a PAT of user-a bound to S, and a PAT of user-b (a member of O, owner of Y) bound to Y
a refusal observer is registered
tests.when: user-a's bound PAT requests X (owner) and user-b's bound PAT requests X (member) for info/refs upload-pack
then: each response is HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
exactly one BoundRefusal is observed per request with Method GET, Route "/git/:org/:slug.git/info/refs", Status 404 and Surface "git"
tests.pseudocode: r = infoRefs(X, boundPat); assert r.code==404; assert len(obs)==1 and obs[0].Surface=='git' and obs[0].Route==template

tests.title: A binding lookup failure is a 500 and the repository is not served
given: a PAT of the owner with a TokenID
the binding table is dropped or otherwise makes the lookup fail
tests.when: that PAT sends GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
then: HTTP 500 with the pkt-line body "ERR internal server error\n"
no advertisement is served
tests.pseudocode: exec('DROP TABLE token_workspace_bindings'); r = infoRefs(pat); assert r.code==500 and r.body==pktline('ERR internal server error\n')

tests.title: A member's PAT bound to W reads W and is refused on push like an unbound PAT
given: user-b is a member of W's org
two PATs of user-b with the same git:write scope, one bound to W and one unbound
tests.when: both send upload-pack and receive-pack requests for W
then: upload-pack returns HTTP 200 for both with equal bodies
receive-pack returns HTTP 403 pkt-line "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n" for both
tests.pseudocode: assert resp(boundPat)==resp(unboundPat) for each route

tests.title: A stranger's bound PAT is refused without a bound-refusal report
given: user-2 is a stranger to W; a PAT of user-2 is bound to another workspace S
a refusal observer is registered
tests.when: that PAT requests W on upload-pack and receive-pack
then: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
no BoundRefusal is observed
tests.pseudocode: assert code==404; assert len(obs)==0

tests.title: Each request gets the status of the first refusing check in the documented order
given: workspaces: ready W, not-ready N, and a stale org-mismatch URL
a blocked user, a stranger, a member, a PAT with no scopes
tests.when: requests are made that trip several checks at once (blocked user on N; stranger on N; stranger with wrong org; member push on W; member push on W with scope-less PAT; owner scope-less PAT on W; URL without .git suffix)
then: blocked user gets 401
URL without .git suffix gets 404 before the resolver lookup
stranger on N gets 404 "repository not available"
wrong org gets 404 "repository not found"
member push gets 403 read-only before the scope check
owner PAT without scope gets 403 "insufficient git permissions"
a database error in the resolver's own lookup is a plain 500 with no body
tests.pseudocode: assert each(case).status/body == expected

tests.title: A not-ready clone is refused before the access decision for every caller
given: workspace N in org O with clone_status 'cloning'
a bound PAT bound elsewhere, a stranger, a member and the owner; a refusal observer
tests.when: each caller requests N on any git route
then: every response is HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not available\n"
no BoundRefusal is observed
a member push also gets 404 not-available rather than the read-only 403
tests.pseudocode: for caller in all: assert body==pktline('ERR repository not available\n')

tests.title: A URL with the wrong org slug is refused before access and reports nothing
given: workspace W in org O and another org P
a PAT bound to a different workspace, owned by W's owner; a refusal observer
tests.when: the PAT and the member's API key request /git/P/W.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
then: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
no BoundRefusal is observed
tests.pseudocode: r = get('/git/P/W.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack'); assert r.code==404; assert len(obs)==0

tests.title: A workspace row that vanishes after the resolver lookup yields the 404
given: a workspaceInfo for slug 'gone' resolved earlier, and the row then deleted from workspaces
an owner's AuthInfo
tests.when: authorizeGitAccess is called with that workspaceInfo
then: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n" is written
errAccessDenied is returned
tests.pseudocode: exec('DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE slug=?', 'gone'); err = authorizeGitAccess(c, db, ws); assert err==errAccessDenied; assert rec.Code==404

tests.title: A workspace with a NULL org_id is a 404 for every caller
given: workspace Z whose org_id is NULL, owned by user-a
an owner API key, an admin token, a stranger and a member of some org
tests.when: each requests /git/<any org slug>/Z.git/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack
then: every response is HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"
none is a 500
tests.pseudocode: seedWorkspace(Z, org=NULL); for c in callers: assert do(c).code==404 and body==notFound

tests.title: WorkspaceLoader.Load reports a NULL-org workspace as not found
given: workspace Z with org_id NULL in the database and a WorkspaceLoader on the workspace root
tests.when: Load is called for the endpoint of Z
then: it returns transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound
no database scan error is returned
tests.pseudocode: _, err = loader.Load(ep); assert errors.Is(err, transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound)

tests.title: Stranger-fixture tests and spec 33/34 git tests keep their assertions once the membership row is dropped
given: TestAuthz_PATWrongOwner_Returns404 and TestAuthz_APIKeyWrongOwner_Returns404 (user-b), TestResolver_NonOwnerNonAdmin_Returns404 (user-2) and newBindingGitEnv (user-b) seeded without the non-owner's org_members row
tests.when: internal/gitserver tests run, including TS-33-42..45, 52, 53, 55, 60 and TS-34-58
then: every test passes with its original assertions unchanged
the non-owner callers receive 404 "repository not found"
TS-34-58 observes exactly one BoundRefusal with the git site
tests.pseudocode: go test ./internal/gitserver -count=1 passes; git diff of these tests shows only removed seedOrgMember lines

tests.title: The git case of TS-35-56 expects member read grant and member write 403
given: a member of the workspace's org, with REST cases of TS-35-56 untouched
tests.when: the member sends upload-pack and receive-pack requests, in the TS-35-56 test
then: upload-pack requests are granted with HTTP 200
receive-pack requests get HTTP 403 with "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n"
the REST assertions of TS-35-56 are unchanged
tests.pseudocode: in TS-35-56: assert git(upload).code==200; assert git(receive).code==403

tests.title: A member clones and fetches a colleague's workspace with the git CLI
given: an httptest server running the full hub git handler chain with a real database
W in org O owned by user-a with a real git repository and commits; user-b is a member of O with an API key
a new commit is added to W after the clone
tests.when: user-b runs git clone then git fetch against http://x-token-auth:<API key>@host/git/O/W.git
then: git clone and git fetch exit 0
local refs equal the refs the owner sees via ls-remote
the new commit is fetched

tests.title: A member's git push is refused with the read-only message and changes nothing
given: an httptest server running the full hub git handler chain with a real database and audit store
W in org O owned by user-a; user-b a member of O who has cloned W with their API key and made a local commit
tests.when: user-b runs git push to /git/O/W.git
then: git push exits non-zero and its output contains "org members have read-only access to this workspace"
the workspace's refs and objects, head_sha and audit event count are unchanged
no hub.git.push audit event exists
